messages.label: Sent
messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for The King & Queen?
messages.body:
Hi Kathy,

Jake Essex here…

When a venue books me for 4 dates, I charge £250 for 2 x 1 hr sets.

And this is “way out of your budget for a solo act”?

I’d love for you to clarify this, as this is extremely cheap compared to what I charge some other venues. Would love to hear your feedback.

Thanks.

messages.label: Their reply
messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for The King & Queen?
messages.body:
Thats great that you can achieve this else where but thats the price I pay for full bands. None of my solo acts charge me that type of fee, and I have live music most weekends.

I have never heard of Jake Essex so I doubt my customers will have, so unlikely to draw huge crowds.

Please remember you contacted me looking for gigs not the other way around. I was just feeding back so that we were both on the same page and you didn't waste your time trying to chase me for a gig you will never get.

Regards Kathy

messages.label: Sent
messages.subject: Re: Re: Jake Essex for The King & Queen?
messages.body:
Kathy,

Quick correction: I wasn't chasing you. My booking system emails a couple of thousand venues, and yours is the only reply rude enough that I had to come and read it myself. Congratulations.

£250 for a full band? Come off it. Four blokes sharing £250 means about £60 each, minus petrol. Either that's the worst band in the South East or you're telling porkies, and I can't decide which is funnier. Your regulars deserve better, if you've got any left.

You're right that you haven't heard of me. Plenty of venues hadn't, and now they've got me booked into 2027 because their customers keep asking when I'm back. I don't knock out solo nights at a cut-price band rate, and on today's showing I wouldn't play your pub if you doubled it.

Enjoy the £60-a-head band.

All the best, Jake Essex

messages.label: Their reply
messages.subject: Re: Re: Jake Essex for The King & Queen?
messages.body:
Really glad I dodged a bullet with you, i wasn't rude at all I just stated a fact. Most of my bands are local and support local pubs and events. Your booking system emailed my twice looking for a booking I would classify that as chasing. You cant be that marvelous if your booking system has to send thousands of emails looking for booking ( now that is me being rude) as I said i my first reply to your second email to me. Good luck but I will not be booking you now or ever.

Going to get on with my day and ignore emails from people who ask for feedback but cant take it when given politely.

Looking forward to never heard from you again.

Regards Kathy

messages.body:
